newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian minister wants death penalty for rape.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian minister wants death penalty for rape.

text.p: Indonesian Women's Affairs Minister Mien Sugandhi on Friday called for the death penalty for rapists while on the campaign trail for the ruling Golkar party, the official Antara news agency reported.

"As Minister for Women's Affairs, I am very concerned to see the sentences which are given to rapists. It is better they are given the death sentence," Sugandhi told a Golkar campaign meeting in Kupang, West Timor.
Sugandhi said the ruling Golkar party would fight to make sure that all officials who handled rape cases, including police, prosecutors and judges, were all women.

"As such the death sentence or a sentence as heavy as possible for rapists can be implemented. A woman's instinct will emerge from a (female) upholder of the law when handling such cases. If a man is handling it, the punishment will not be just," she said.
The maximum sentence for rape under Indonesia's existing criminal code is 12 years' jail. The death penalty applies only to cases of murder and subversion.
